help.title: Help & support
help.subtitle: Answers to common questions and contact.

faqs.q: How do I upgrade to Premium?
faqs.a: Open Pricing, pick an app and a plan, then complete checkout with Stripe or PayPal.

faqs.q: How can I change my language?
faqs.a: In Settings pick your language (BS/EN/DE). It is saved to your profile.

faqs.q: How do I cancel a subscription?
faqs.a: Go to My subscriptions to manage or cancel any active plan.

faqs.q: How do I edit my profile?
faqs.a: Open My profile in the sidebar to update details, avatar and contacts.
Check Settings to ensure email notifications are on and look in your spam folder.
Use the form below — your message is sent to our team directly.

users.identityLockedNote: Name, profile photo, and email come from the user's identity provider and are locked — not editable here. Email is kept in sync automatically on every sign-in.

rewards.title: Rewards & Loyalty
rewards.subtitle: Action rules, levels, achievements, the redemption catalog, fulfillment types, and configuration.
rewards.actionRulesHint: The sole lookup for how many points each action grants — no action is ever hardcoded elsewhere.
rewards.levelsHint: A user's level is whichever level's threshold their Lifetime Points currently clear — resolved generically, not hardcoded.
rewards.milestonesHint: Points + successful-invite tiers that grant Premium automatically via the existing fulfillment mechanism. "Successful invite" = registered and completed profile.
rewards.catalogHint: Redeeming requires both the points threshold and the verified-referrals threshold. Fulfillment is recorded as pending — see Fulfillment Types below.
rewards.fulfillmentTypesHint: A registry, not a fixed enum — a future module can register its own fulfillment type without a deployment. Rewards only records which type a redemption needs; acting on it stays with the owning module.
rewards.referralVerificationHint: How long a Premium Referral must stay verified-Premium before it counts toward catalog thresholds.

applications.title: Applications & Plans
applications.newApplicationHint: Registers a new application. It automatically gets every Core capability (auth, profiles, billing, notifications, permissions, audit log) with no further setup. It's created disabled — add plans and branding below, then switch it on in App Settings once it's ready.
applications.productsHint: Every purchasable item for this application — Premium subscriptions, promotions, and one-time purchases are all Products, priced and configured the same way.
applications.name: Name
applications.googleClientIdHint: This application's own Google Cloud OAuth Client ID (its own consent-screen name/logo). Not secret. The Client Secret is never stored here — it stays only in Supabase's Auth provider configuration.
applications.noneFallThrough: None (fall through to next resolution step)
applications.languageHint: Launch date is informational only — shown next to a "Coming Soon" application, never used to activate it automatically. Default language is step 3 of the API's locale resolution order (Accept-Language header → user's own profile language → this → English).
applications.visibilityImmutableHint: Changing visibility is always this one explicit action — nothing in this codebase ever changes it automatically, even once a launch date has passed.
applications.shareInviteHint: Leave a field blank to use the built-in default. Share is application-focused (shown regardless of who is sharing); Invite is personal and supports the placeholders
